Currently, I have to manually calculate how much I’ve invested in equity funds and track their returns because both equity and debt funds are combined in the dashboard. A portfolio feature would make it much easier to organize and visualize different categories, such as wealth-building funds and goal-based funds, while also showing the total investment and returns for each portfolio separately.

This would greatly improve portfolio tracking and provide a much better user experience.

Overall, a great app for beginners and intermediate users who want a hassle-free investing experience.

reviews.title: DONT USE THIS PLATFORM FOR TRADING
reviews.text:
Do not use this broker for trading or F&O. Use it only for investments, SIPs, or mutual funds.

Absolutely avoid it for F&O and commodities. Their so-called 9:15 platform is extremely frustrating and unreliable. It constantly freezes and becomes unusable when you actually need it most.

Whenever you:
• Try to execute an order — it gets stuck
• Change the timeframe — it gets stuck
• Click Buy/Sell — it gets stuck
• Modify trailing stop-loss or target orders — it gets stuck

I have made plenty of losses over the past 2 weeks because of this incompetent and useless platform. Delays and execution issues in trading are not minor inconveniences — they directly affect money and trading decisions.

The worst part is that even after providing live screen recordings of the issue, the only response from support is the usual: “Clear browser data and reinstall the app.”

That is not a solution when real money and trade execution are involved. Reliability during market hours is the most basic requirement of a trading platform, and repeatedly facing such issues is unacceptable.

P.S. This review is specifically for the web terminal on MacBook.

reviews.title: Interface for ipads
reviews.text:
The app really needs a proper interface designed specifically for iPad. Right now, it is quite difficult and uncomfortable to use on a larger screen. The layout does not feel optimized, and many elements seem stretched or poorly aligned, which affects usability.

Navigation can also be confusing at times, and simple tasks take more effort than they should. An iPad-friendly interface with better spacing, improved responsiveness, and optimized controls would make a big difference in the overall user experience.

I hope the developers consider adding a dedicated iPad interface in future updates, as it would greatly improve accessibility and ease of use.

What I like most is how straightforward everything feels — from KYC to making your first investment, the whole process is smooth and doesnt feel overwhelming. The app also provides basic explanations and insights, which are useful if you’re still learning the ropes.
That said, theres still room for improvement. Sometimes the app can lag a bit during peak market hours, and I wish they had more advanced tools for experienced investors. But for beginners and even intermediate users, it does the job really well.
Overall, Groww is a solid choice if you want a no-nonsense, user-friendly platform to start your investment journey without getting lost in complicated features.

reviews.title: iPad Version Performance & UI Issues
reviews.text:
I would like to share my feedback regarding the iPad version of the Groww app. While the platform is efficient and user-friendly on mobile devices, the experience on iPad currently requires improvement.

Firstly, the app interface does not appear to be fully optimized for iPad dimensions. The layout feels stretched and misaligned, which affects usability and overall visual appeal. A dedicated iPad-responsive design would significantly enhance the experience.

Secondly, there are noticeable performance issues with charts. The charts tend to lag during interaction, especially while scrolling, zooming, or switching timeframes. This delay can hinder effective analysis, particularly for active traders who rely on real-time responsiveness.

These issues impact both usability and efficiency. I hope the development team considers optimizing the app for iPad screens and improving chart performance in upcoming updates.

reviews.title: Great Platform, But Where is the iPad App?
reviews.text:
Groww offers one of the most intuitive and clean interfaces for investing, but it is becoming increasingly difficult to overlook the lack of a native iPadOS application.

While the iPhone app is excellent, using it on an iPad feels like a massive step backward. Currently, iPad users are forced to use the scaled-up iPhone version, which results in:

Wasted Space: Massive black bars on the sides and a layout that doesn't utilize the extra screen real estate for multi-chart viewing or deeper data analysis.

Inconvenience: Most major competitors already offer dedicated, high-resolution iPad apps that allow for a much more professional "terminal" feel.

For a platform that prides itself on technology and user experience, it’s disappointing that power users are stuck with a mobile-only layout. Navigating complex portfolios or analyzing candlesticks is far more convenient on a tablet, but only if the app is designed for it.

Bottom line: Please bring a dedicated iPad app to the ecosystem. Until then, it’s hard to call this a complete cross-platform solution.

reviews.title: Unfair Practice – Mutual Fund Units Stored in DEMAT Without Investor Consent
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Groww App for mutual fund investments, but I’m quite disappointed with a major concern that hasn’t been addressed.

Groww is directly storing mutual fund units in DEMAT format without taking proper consent or providing clear choice to investors regarding their preferred holding format — whether DEMAT or SOA (Statement of Account).

Many investors prefer SOA format as it gives more flexibility (especially for switching platforms or offline transactions) and avoids unnecessary DP charges. However, Groww doesn’t offer an option to choose and automatically links all investments to the DEMAT account held with them.

This is not just a matter of user experience, but an important investment decision, and Groww must take explicit consent from the investor before choosing the holding format. For a platform that claims to be investor-friendly, this is quite disappointing.

I hope Groww takes this feedback seriously and starts providing the option to select the holding mode during mutual fund investment – the way other platforms like Sharekhan or MF Central do.

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Experience – Worst Customer Support
reviews.text:
I took a loan against my mutual funds through the Groww app. I have fully cleared all my loan payments, yet I am still unable to sell my mutual funds because they remain pledged.

The worst part is that the app does not provide any direct option to unpledge mutual funds after loan closure. The only option given is to call customer support — which is absolutely pathetic.

I have called more than 100 times. Every single time, the IVR says “Your queue position is 1”, then after 10 minutes and 30 seconds, the call goes completely silent and disconnects. You are forced to call again and face the same issue repeatedly. This feels intentional and highly unprofessional.

There is no callback, no resolution, no accountability. For a fintech app handling people’s investments, this level of service is unacceptable. My money is effectively stuck even after clearing all dues.

This is by far the worst app experience I have ever had. Poor design, zero transparency, and horrible customer support.
Strongly advise everyone to stay away from Groww, especially for loan-against-MF services. Once your funds are pledged, getting them released is a nightmare.

reviews.title: Worst Trading Platform with Skyrocketing Brokerage Fees
reviews.text:
As a seasoned options trader in the Indian derivatives market, I approached the Groww app expecting a seamless platform for executing trades on Nifty and Sensex indices. Unfortunately, Groww proves to be one of the worst options available for active trading, plagued by persistent performance issues and an exorbitantly high brokerage structure that erodes profitability.

The app’s trading interface is riddle with delays, frequent crashes during peak market hours, and unreliable order execution—critical flaws for intraday strategies.

Worse still, Groww’s brokerage fees escalate exponentially for frequent trades, with hidden charges on options contracts that can wipe out gains on even moderately active positions.

While Groww suits casual investors dipping into mutual funds, it falls catastrophically short for professional trading needs. I strongly advise steering clear if you’re serious about derivatives—opt for brokers with lower, transparent fees and robust execution instead.

reviews.title: Grow with Groww
reviews.text:
Groww has quickly emerged as one of India's top trading and wealth management apps, praised for its intuitive user interface, wide range of features, and transparent pricing. The app offers seamless investing in stocks, mutual funds, IPOs, and advanced options trading tools, making it accessible for both beginners and experienced investors. Its user-friendly design and secure platform—with features like 128-bit encryption—provide a safe and efficient investment experience for millions of Indians.

The recent merger with Fisdom Private Wealth marks a transformational milestone for Groww, elevating it to India’s top wealth advisory platform.

This strategic acquisition—valued at around $150 million—adds robust wealth management offerings including mutual funds, pension services, and insurance to Groww’s already expansive investment suite. The integration of Fisdom’s expertise and team strengthens Groww’s capability to serve HNI and affluent clients through personalized and comprehensive advisory services.

Groww’s deep penetration into Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities and a large, young user base reflect its commitment to financial inclusion and tech-driven empowerment in India.

Following the merger, Groww now leverages Fisdom’s wealth solutions and its own massive retail network, ensuring clients get access to the best-in-class wealth management, superior advisory, and innovative investment products with continued customer-first values.

Overall, Groww stands out for:
- Simple, smooth, and secure trading and investment platform.
- Strong customer ratings and industry-leading active user count].
- Enhanced wealth advisory and diversified financial products post-Fisdom merger.
- Excellent support for both retail investors and affluent HNI clients.

This bold move has set Groww apart as India’s foremost modern wealth advisory and investment gateway, trusted by millions for all their financial growth needs.

Hi everyone, please don’t use this app!

At first, they said my name was incorrect, so I changed my name and bank details. Later, when I tried to redeem my amount and proceeded with the process, they didn’t inform me that I also needed to update my name in the stock records.

The app showed that my amount was already transferred to my bank account. When I asked for the transaction ID, they told me to check my bank and share my bank statement. After I shared it, they replied saying, “Oh sir, your name is incorrect.”

If my name was incorrect, then how could the app show that the amount was already transferred?

When I contacted Groww customer support, they said I had to connect with the Parag Parikh Fund team for this issue.

So please, be careful and think twice before using this app.

reviews.title: Broker glitch
reviews.text:
The app is good and user friendly but it has a major issue of closing up positions in trading.
I do think know if this happens to other people but many times when i try to exit my position, it won’t exit.
I do everything right, my strategy, stop loss, target, but when i reach my target and try to manually exit the position, it won’t exit, and no this is not always the case as sometimes the entry and exit are instant but in a high volume stock where there is so many shares and noise all over, the position becomes glitchy 
And it didn’t bothered me that much until today, i tried to exit my position at a profit of Rs240, which is not a lot for many of you, but for me with a 3k total capital in my account balance, THIS HURT, as my 240 profit turned into 23. I had to cancel the order because i panicked as the taxes and brokerage would eat up 40-50 rupees, so yeah i made a loss after trying to exit at 240 profit 
Now tell me, if a person like me who is trying to learn trading with a limited capital gets a 240 profit on a 3k account but then the app decides to slap his face, how would you guys feel.

reviews.title: Groww Needs some Improvements.
reviews.text:
Groww is an excellent app for trading, but there are a few issues and missing features that could make it much better:
	1.	When indicators are added to the chart, they disappear after switching to full-screen mode. This happens on both the app and desktop version, and it becomes frustrating to re-add them repeatedly.
	2.	Please add trailing stop loss, stop loss by percentage, and an option to set stop loss and take profit simultaneously. These features are common in trading platforms and will save users a lot of time.

Fixing these points will make the app more polished and efficient for serious traders.

reviews.title: Slow processing of transactions & price updation and bad customer care service.
reviews.text: The app is quite disappointing for serious traders. The stock prices update very slowly, which makes it difficult to take timely decisions—something that is absolutely essential in trading. On top of that, my mutual fund order has been stuck under “processing” even after 2 days, which shows poor backend efficiency. Needs major improvements in speed and reliability. The customer care service of this app is extremely poor. Calls get disconnected before the issue is resolved, and to make matters worse, the support tickets are marked as “resolved” even though the problem is still pending. This is very frustrating and shows a lack of accountability. Proper support is just as important as trading features, and this app needs serious improvement in its customer service.

reviews.text:
I’m honestly fed up with the constant technical issues on the Groww app. It has become a nightmare to rely on during crucial trading hours. Multiple times, I’ve faced funding failures right when I needed to average my position—and because of this, I’ve had to watch potential profits turn into losses.

What’s the point of a trading app if it fails when you need it the most?

The most frustrating part is that these errors happen again and again, especially during market volatility or peak trading times. It seems like Groww isn’t prepared to handle real-time trading needs. There’s no proper warning, no quick resolution—just spinning wheels and payment failures.

For a platform that promotes itself as user-friendly and reliable, this is totally unacceptable. I’ve lost both money and trust because of Groww’s poor infrastructure.

If you’re serious about trading or investing actively, I would recommend looking for a more stable and professional platform. Groww is fine for watching charts, but when it comes to execution, it can fail you exactly when you need it most.

reviews.text: The Groww app strikes an excellent balance between simplicity and powerful performance, making it ideal for both new and seasoned investors. Its clean, intuitive interface ensures smooth navigation, while fast execution and real-time updates deliver a seamless investing experience. Despite its minimalist design, Groww offers robust features like SIP tracking, portfolio analytics, and secure two-factor authentication. With transparent pricing and minimal clutter, it’s a reliable, no-nonsense tool that simplifies investing without compromising on functionality.

reviews.title: Concern Regarding Increased DP Charges and Request for Revision
reviews.text:
I am writing to express my concern regarding the recent revision in DP charges. It has come to my attention that the DP charges have now been changed from a "per company per day" basis to a "per order" basis, which I find quite disappointing.

Additionally, the minimum brokerage of ₹5 on even a single stock purchase—compared to the earlier 0.01% (with a cap of ₹20)—makes it increasingly difficult for small retail investors like me to trade in low quantities. This change discourages participation in the market, especially for those who are just starting out or prefer small-volume investments.

I sincerely request you to reconsider and revise the DP charge structure, making it more affordable and supportive of retail investors.

reviews.title: Login Problem
reviews.text: I, along with my family and cousins, have been facing login problems with the Groww app for quite some time. High log-in difficulty is accompanied by high activity periods for the stock like huge dips or surges. I've missed crucial trades because of these blocks, and as a result, I've lost a lot of money. Why is this app so unreliable? A stock trading app should be the most reliable tool during crucial times since even a second can make a difference. reviews.title: Pathetic experience
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience with the Grow app. The interface is clunky and not user-friendly, making it difficult to navigate and find essential features. The app is also riddled with bugs, causing frequent crashes, especially during crucial tasks like payments or fund transfers. Customer support is practically non-existent — emails go unanswered, and there’s no way to get quick resolutions to issues. Additionally, the app often takes forever to update real-time data, leading to delays in decision-making. Overall, I wouldn’t recommend this app to anyone serious about managing their investments or finances.

Problems with latest update :

- Please work on adding new features instead of giving an update for UI.

- While placing order and selecting quantities, the keyboard is now removed so I have to manually tap 36 times to get to 900 quantities.

reviews.text: Groww is the best app for investing in stocks, mutual funds etc. Any newbie can use it easily without getting stuck in between. The onboarding process is so seamless like anyone can easily complete it. The UI/UX is also one of the best, very minimalist, simple and easy to use.

reviews.title: Great investment app
reviews.text:
I've been using the Groww app for a while now, and it's been a game-changer for me. The interface is super easy to use, even if you're just starting out with investing. They offer a variety of options like stocks and mutual funds, which is awesome.

What really stands out to me are the educational resources. The articles and tutorials are really helpful and have taught me a lot about investing. Plus, the customer support team is very responsive and always ready to help.

The real-time data and analytics are spot on, which makes it easier to make informed decisions. I also feel safe using the app since they seem to take security seriously.

Overall, Groww has been a great experience and has definitely helped me get more confident with my investments. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to start or improve their investment journey!

reviews.title: Extremely Poor Customer Service and Refund Issues
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the customer service at Groww. There is no option to set up auto-pay, which is a basic feature that should be available. I ended up paying twice for the same SIP, and when I reached out for a refund of the extra amount, no one bothered to respond.

It's been around four days now with no acknowledgment or resolution from the Groww customer team. This lack of response and support is unacceptable. I expected better from a reputed platform like Groww. I hope this issue gets resolved soon and Groww improves its customer service and introduces essential features like auto-pay setup.

reviews.title: Reliability issues

I faced a lot of reliability issues like frequently logged off from app by itself and payment failures.  I had consistent payment failure for my sip payment for straight 10 days. I contacted grow support and they did not even cared to take a complaint, instead suggested to use any other payment method. Why would i when i can use another broker. Byebye

This is extremely frustrating, especially when timely updates are crucial for account security and receiving important notifications. Groww really needs to streamline this process and improve their customer service. Disappointed with the lack of efficiency and responsiveness.

reviews.title: Horrible Customer Support
reviews.text:
They have an estimated 35~40mins waiting time if you want to reach out to them over chat. 
And each and every response you get from them via chat is superficial. Customer care executives hardly take the effort to truly understand your issue and end up repeating the same lines over and over again. 

Tickets are a better way to reach them but that too is horrible! I have raised couple of tickets which were left high and dry without any responses after the initial back and forth on the issue. They just drop your ticket in midst of the issue resolution. 

And calls? Thats a joke! 
You end up staying in line for over an hour but still you wont find anyone on the other side to take your call. 

I am leaving this stupid app- other apps are much better with hell and heaven difference in customer support compared to Groww!

reviews.title: Delayed Unit Allotment Negates Convenience: My Final Investment on Groww
reviews.text:
I specifically came here to share my experience because the app prompted me for a review. However, it appears that if you rate the app lower, they hide the submit review button just below the screen, making it difficult to submit.

Now, let's get to the real reasons for my lower rating. All payment-related processes, such as purchasing mutual fund units, setting up auto-pay, and linking your bank account, are executed swiftly. However, the real problem arises when it comes to unit allotment, which takes a frustratingly long 5-6 days. In the fast-paced stock market, every day matters, and you can't predict what might happen tomorrow. Even if you've conducted thorough research before investing, it becomes almost useless.

Regrettably, this will be my last investment on Groww.

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience with Groww App
reviews.text:
I must express my extreme disappointment with the Groww app. It has been nothing but a frustrating experience since I started using it. Here are some of the issues I've encountered:

1. **Technical Glitches:** The app frequently crashes and freezes, making it almost impossible to perform even basic tasks like checking my portfolio or placing orders.

2. **Slow Updates:** The market data on the app is often delayed, making it unreliable for real-time trading or tracking investments accurately.

3. **Limited Features:** Groww lacks many essential features that other investment apps offer, such as advanced charting tools, options trading, and in-depth research capabilities.

4. **Customer Support:** When I faced issues and tried to reach out to customer support, I received slow and unhelpful responses, leaving me feeling unsupported as a user.

Overall, my experience with the Groww app has been frustrating and unsatisfactory. I would not recommend it to anyone serious about managing their investments effectively.

reviews.title: App speed
reviews.text:
Groww is an investment app that boasts a great user interface, making it easy for users to navigate and invest. However, the overall experience is marred by persistent speed issues on both the app and web versions. This slowdown significantly impacts the user experience and can lead to potential losses due to delayed order placement.

One of the most frustrating aspects of Groww is the slow order placement process. It takes an unacceptably long time to execute orders, which can be especially problematic in a fast-paced market where timing is critical. The delays can result in unfavorable price changes, leading to financial losses and additional charges.

While it's commendable that Groww releases regular updates, it's disappointing that these updates have not addressed the core issue of speed. Users would likely appreciate more substantial improvements in this area.

reviews.title: Incorrect Average holding price
reviews.text:
The average stock price shown in the portfolio is incorrect. I made various meaningful conversations and mails but no use.

I want all of you to check the average value of a  particular stock or portfolio of your holding. Groww team is so confident that in our portfolio average, they also consider intraday transactions of that and show the average price.

Ideally the average portfolio value shouldn’t be using the intraday buy orders but Groww does and they argue it is correct and refer everything to SEBI or RBI norms.

Here is an example  :

Why is Groww platform showing incorrect average price without following FIFO? Please see the mail attached and share your comments

Example: The following are the transactions in sequence for Same Share/Stock in the same day:

Buy 1 qty at 100 INR at 10:00am

Sell 1 qty at 95 INR at 10:30 am

Buy 1 qty at 90 INR at 11:00 am and take delivery of this 1 qty.

Groww shows average buy price is 95 instead of 90 INR. Why is intraday transaction buy value considered to show the average holding value of stock? Why would anyone average intraday and holding value to show average buy value of a stock?

reviews.title: Disappointing Trading Experience with the Groww App
reviews.text:
I have been using the Groww app for my trading activities for some time now, and unfortunately, my experience has been far from satisfactory. The app's regular lagging during trading sessions is incredibly frustrating and has cost me valuable opportunities. It's quite disheartening to see such a fundamental flaw persisting in the app despite repeated updates. 
 
One of the most crucial features for any trading app is a reliable stop-loss mechanism. Regrettably, Groww's stop-loss functionality is far from dependable. There have been numerous instances where the stop-loss orders were not executed properly, causing significant losses on my trades. It's alarming to see stop-loss orders being executed at 5% loss, only to refresh the app and find it has ballooned to 15% or even 20%. Such discrepancies are simply unacceptable and have shaken my trust in the app. 
 
Moreover, the lack of prompt customer support from Groww adds to the frustration. When I encountered issues with the app, reaching out for assistance proved to be an arduous process, and the responses were often generic and unhelpful. 
 
The app's user interface is visually appealing and offers a wide variety of investment options, but all of these features become meaningless if the basic functionality of the app is severely flawed. 
 
As a result of these consistent issues, I can't help but consider Groww as one of the worst trading apps I've ever used. Trading is a fast-paced activity, and such lags and glitches can have severe financial consequences for users. I genuinely hope that Groww addresses these issues promptly and diligently, as it has the potential to be a great platform if it can deliver a seamless and reliable trading experience. 
 
In its current state, I cannot recommend the Groww app for trading purposes. It's vital to have confidence in the platform you use for investing, and unfortunately, the app's persistent lagging and unreliable stop-loss functionality have robbed me of that trust. Until substantial improvements are made, I will be exploring other options for my trading needs

I have been a long time user of groww and has been investigating in long term/short term/equity/debt/liquid funds for past many years. Ranging from 10k~50k per month.
But groww now has become waste of money and time. It takes more than a week for unit allocation or reach withdrawals to your account. They have brokerage and fees to all possible transaction. I quit.

Piece of advice: Invest directly into the MF on their website. All have fully functional websites which allows all options of one time or SIP, and you don’t have to pay any brokerage.

reviews.title: Worst app
reviews.text:
Such a bad app, they have technical breakdown during the trading time. I had bought shares in intraday trading and I had received the delivery message but the shares were not reflected in my dashboard for around 2 hours due to this I couldn’t sell those share as it was making loss. When I reported this to the team , they casually ignored saying that it was technical breakdown and it was restored within few time( 2 hours is few time for them) in this much time any one can have huge loss.

After 2 hours when the shares reflected in my dashboard I had to sell those shares for loss. 

Be careful guys this can happen to anyone and u will have to bear huge loss( maybe be in thousand or lacks if the market is volatile). Better you use upstox or Zerodha

reviews.title: Good Interface but really worst platform for investment
reviews.text:

I tried to even call the customer support, after a long research on google finally got a customer support number and tried contacting them, which redirects to another number, held myself for around 10-15 minutes on the call and no one answers.

 I am completely fed up with GROWW and i have switched to FISDOM which gives users a great customer support and really good and easy setup process. PLEASE PLEASE STOP USING THIS APPLICATION.

reviews.title: Pathetic app.... never install
reviews.text:
These guys are too crook.... everything including PAN Card is verified when it is installed. It works perfectly fine...
Then while adding money as well as during investment, they are very proactive and investment is all done within fraction of seconds. 

Now comes the twists in the tale... when u intend to withdraw your money.... like me... firstly, it shows min 3/4days for money to be transferred to bank, thereafter, at the last stage they show true colour by giving thousands of reasons as why it can’t be done. Like in my case where error was shown as mismatch of pan no. How can it be practically possible when all verification was done and money was also accepted using the same pan no. At least be intelligent to give a genuine looking issue. Inspite of four continues attempts in last 10 days, I’m unable to withdraw my money. 

when the issue was informed to the Support team by raising ticket in the same day of first instance, reply come after 3 days. Reply’s are all dummy, standard one liners... we are looking into it... will be resolved soon... etc. 

This app seems to be a big hoax.... request all to withdraw your valuable cash if already installed and uninstall this app. Else for those intending to install, don’t do this blunder. I intend to raise this issue legally and shown them their place.

reviews.title: I don’t feel safe
reviews.text:
There are so many UX and Customer Service issues with this app, that it’s hard to know where to even begin. Money inexplicably disappears, transactions fail without any announcement to the user, and any problem can only be solved by a slow and lengthy Support process. The only thing that is instant in this app is when you’re spending money in it. For everything else, there is a turnaround time. 

For reference, there is a large sum of money, roughly about half my monthly salary, that this app is holding hostage. There is no place in the app where you can see where this money is, the app shows zero balance. The only place where there is a mention of it is the Customer Support chat. I took several screenshots of that. I don’t trust Groww. 

I am losing trust in this app, and trying to figure out how to migrate my assets to another app. I recommend you avoid this app if you value your earnings.

reviews.title: I just love the Interface

Just a few feature suggestions:
1) Implement stocks search  in such a way so that the current price, increase/decrease along with percentages are visible in the search results itself (like Paytm money). Currently we have to click on search result to view that which is an extra and avoidable step.
 2) It keeps logging me out every day. I have to login every morning which is cumbersome. Additionally it does not save my dark mode settings with my email id. Every time I login I have to enable dark mode again.

reviews.title: Utter chaos and ultimately loss making app
reviews.text:
When I signed up, until I uploaded all the documents they kept reading me about it and once I uploaded they didn’t bother to do any KYC. But the dashboard didn’t show anything pending on my side. When I decided to checkout the app with a small amount, they waited until I transferred the money and then told me my ePAN cannot be accepted for KYC and kept my order pending. Note the NAV was around INR 27. Despite explaining on 2 calls they wouldn’t respect IT department directive that ePAN is equally valid. So I told them to refund the money, they replied we have initiated the refund and it will come back to account in 3 working days. Simultaneously another of their executive kept emailing me several times for me to email him the PAN scan.  I didn’t bother to reply as my refund was in progress as per the Team Lead who spoke last. Separately 2 days later I found the PAN scan and uploaded it in the app. Now suddenly on Monday 3 days after my request for refund, I receive a note saying the money has been sent to the Mutual Fund and units will be allocated in 3 or 4 days.  Finally the next day I receive a note saying I have been allocated x units @ NAV INR 29. Not only I had lost INR 2 per unit because of Groww’s mistakes and delays but also the cancellation that was initiated did not happen or they plainly lied to a customer. 

If this is how investors have to suffer at the hands of new age Brokers like Groww, I would rather desist from investing through such cheap apps. 

It’s funny their slogan is “proudly built in India for India.”  They are apparently in business from 2016. Maybe that’s their level of professionalism. But they should drag the country’s reputation along with it. I humbly request them to change their slogan.

. While investing, they allocate the units according to the date you invested, but while redeeming they don’t want you to redeem your money when it is at a higher value.

reviews.title: Totally legit, found it to be trustworthy
reviews.text:
I am using the services offered by groww app since 5 months. At first, i was really sceptical about investing through them, but as I invested through the app, I got to know the legitimacy and transparency of the process through which I got my money invested to plethora of funds. 

Yes, there is a problem of late update of NAVs, but it is okay as they offer me the DIRECT funds rather than the REGULAR PLANS which deduct commissions from your money. 

All the funds are cleared through INDIAN CLEARING CORPORATION which is a subsidiary of BSE to clear funds for transactions like this, and you can also check with the fund house in which you invested your money directly about the funds. 

I would staunchly suggest to go with the GROWW to invest in DIRECT plan funds. There is no catch about it, they just charge commission on the REGULAR PLANS they offer, not on the DIRECT PLANS.

reviews.text:
The major drawback is “the NAV’s are not updating regularly. All AMC’s are updating their NAV values by 10-10:30 PM every day into amfi (all mutual fund association in India) central server from there different parties like grow, cams, mfutility etc.. pull-up data. All the rest of the portals are updating their sites in between 12AM-2 AM. But groww app and its site are updating NAV values after 8AM sometimes. I am writing this review at 8:30 AM, still I couldn’t see the latest NAV against the mutual fund I invested through Groww..I am observing this situation from the time when I have been invested.

My suggestion to Groww is to make your app and site to get update NAV values as fast as possible at least say by 6AM.

Also, the NAV’s are rounding off to nearest vales, which leads to some confusion.

No other major issues observed. It’s simple and straightforward to begin and use.

reviews.title: Account frozen, useless support, cost me thousands
reviews.text:
I have been locked out of my own investments due to a "ReKYC" process that the app explicitly claims takes "1-2 days." It has now been well over a week, and my account is still completely frozen with a systemic error stating onboarding is not allowed.
Because Groww restricted my account, I was prevented from executing a time-sensitive sell order on August 28th. I urgently requested their support chat to manually execute the trade on my behalf to prevent a financial hit, but I was completely ignored. As a direct result of this operational failure and their account lock, my position dropped, and I suffered a direct loss of ₹4,000 in profits that I was actively trying to book.
The customer service is abysmal. The escalation team operates in a continuous loop, closing out my tickets with automated, copy-pasted templates stating the issue is "prioritized" and "forwarded to the concerned team," yet the account remains blocked and the issue is never actually resolved.
If you want a reliable broker where you can actually access your portfolio and sell your shares during crucial market moments, look elsewhere. Groww's system delays and completely unresponsive support will literally cost you money.
Highly disappointing experience.

I am writing to express my extreme disappointment with the repeated glitches and technical failures on the Groww app.

Today was the final straw. A trading platform should be reliable, especially during market hours when every second matters. Instead, I have repeatedly experienced issues that have affected my trading experience and confidence in your platform.

It is incredibly frustrating to trust an app with my hard-earned money only to face technical glitches when reliability matters the most. These recurring problems have caused unnecessary stress and have made trading through Groww an unpleasant experience.

Because of these repeated failures, I have decided to withdraw my trading journey from Groww. This has been, without a doubt, the worst trading platform experience I have ever had. I expected stability and professionalism, but instead I encountered glitches and poor reliability.

I request that you investigate these issues seriously. No trader should have to suffer losses, anxiety, or missed opportunities because of platform failures.

I will be moving my trading activities elsewhere. I hope you take customer complaints like this seriously and improve your platform for those who continue to use it.
